v2_meta.description: SDXL text-to-image base workflow for the Main Posts V2 pipeline. The Main Posts LoRA (lora_main_posts, asset_id lora_main_posts, trigger azink_main) is load-bearing: LoraLoader (node 11) sits on both the model and CLIP conditioning paths feeding the KSampler and CLIPTextEncode nodes. This mirrors the proven Realistic Posts base topology (M6) so the load-bearing contract is identical, but the profile identity, LoRA asset, LoRA strength, and conditioning are distinct for Main Posts. ControlNet / IP-Adapter / Mask optional capabilities are DISABLED_FOR_BASE_PROFILE and are intentionally absent from this base graph. Semantic inputs are resolved deterministically from GenerationSpec by tools/main_posts_pipeline_v2.run_main_posts_resolution. Profile identity is carried on GenerationSpec.style.pipeline='main_posts'; the M1 ALLOWED_PIPELINES whitelist ('comic','realistic') is intentionally NOT extended under this bounded authority (M1_CONTRACT_MUTATION_AUTHORIZED=NO), so Main Posts validates through its own dedicated contract rather than the frozen M1 validator.
